record.paper_title: Developments and open problems on chiral polytopes
record.context_brief: universal chiral extensions of regular polytopes
record.original_question: For every regular polytope K, does there exist a chiral extension of K that covers every other extension of K?

evidence.quote: Problem 24 Determine whether for every (any) regular polytope K there exists a chiral extension which covers every extension of K.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions. An abstract polytope of rank $n$ is a partially ordered set $P$ (with a minimum and a maximum element) whose elements (called faces) are graded by rank in $\{-1,0,1,\dots,n\}$, satisfying the diamond condition and strong flag-connectedness. The maximal chains of $P$ are called flags. The automorphism group $\Gamma(P)$ acts freely on flags. The polytope $P$ is regular if $\Gamma(P)$ acts transitively on flags, and chiral if $\Gamma(P)$ has exactly two orbits on flags such that adjacent flags lie in different orbits.

Given an abstract polytope $K$ of rank $n$, an extension of $K$ is an abstract polytope $P$ of rank $n+1$ all of whose facets (faces of rank $n$) are isomorphic to $K$. A covering between polytopes $P \to Q$ of the same rank is a rank- and incidence-preserving surjection that maps flags to flags. An extension $P$ of $K$ is said to cover another extension $Q$ of $K$ if there is such a covering $P \to Q$.

Problem. Let $K$ be an arbitrary regular abstract polytope. Does there exist a chiral extension $P$ of $K$ such that, for every chiral extension $Q$ of $K$, there is a covering $P \to Q$? Equivalently, does $K$ admit a universal chiral extension in the category of chiral extensions of $K$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in Pellicer's list of open problems on chiral polytopes and continues to be cited as open in subsequent literature (e.g., Cunningham–Pellicer on chiral extensions, Montero's work on Schläfli symbols of chiral extensions, and Pellicer's 2025 book "Abstract Chiral Polytopes" which still lists open problems in this direction). No resolution was found in the search.

status_evidence.title: Chiral extensions of chiral polytopes (Cunningham–Pellicer)
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs chiral (d+1)-polytopes with facets isomorphic to a given chiral d-polytope with regular facets; does not resolve the universal chiral extension problem for arbitrary regular K.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work on chiral extensions does not establish a universal chiral extension over an arbitrary regular polytope K.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems (Appendix C) - Abstract Chiral Polytopes
status_evidence.snippet: Appendix listing open problems in the theory of abstract chiral polytopes.
status_evidence.claim: Universal chiral extension questions remain among the listed open problems.

status_evidence.title: On the Schläfli symbol of chiral extensions of polytopes (Montero)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies existence of chiral extensions with prescribed Schläfli data; does not provide universal covers among all chiral extensions of a regular K.
status_evidence.claim: Recent constructive work does not yield a universal chiral extension.
